# mod-raid-loot-expansion

**AzerothCore module** — Full cross-expansion raid loot scaling (Classic + TBC + WotLK) for levels 60/70/80.

## Features

- Creates **new item copies only** (original database items are untouched)

- Level 80 players → everything upscaled to WotLK power

- Level 70 players → Classic upscaled, TBC appropriate, WotLK downscaled

- Level 60 players → Classic appropriate, TBC & WotLK downscaled

- Fully configurable via config file

- Works alongside mod-autobalance

## Installation

1. Clone into your modules folder:

```bash

cd modules

git clone https://github.com/blakehughes97-web/mod-raid-loot-expansion.git
